title: 第17章 母子相谈黎清月能漂亮到哪里去第18章 一副画像混乱星海
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 对于自己的父皇，他们心中在了解不过。
恐怕这次宁国候的刻意针对，惹的虞皇心中不悦了，这才故意当众赏赐这禁令给孟尘。
否则，赏赐这种东西，完全可以私下里进行。
毕竟，孟尘可是提前见过虞皇的，那个时候没有给，足以说明虞皇最初是没有这个意思的。
虞皇送出这块禁令，殿内众人皆不语，连一声都不敢吭了。
虞皇是不是真宠爱孟尘，他们不清楚。
但眼下，明面上绝对是要支持孟尘的，因为这是他亲自下令接回，并且赐婚，想要用来制衡各方势力的棋子。
在孟尘成气候前，这接风宴上，岂能让人随意践踏？
至于质疑孟尘暗中投靠敌国这种话术，显然更不起作用。
乍一看很有逻辑，但细细想来却没有任何效果。
首先，孟尘是大虞皇室血脉，为大虞安宁身困敌国八年时间，如今又是虞皇主动接回。
这一切，都是虞皇出手促成。
质疑孟尘，岂不是与虞皇作对？
眼下，他们只能从秋岚狩猎上找回面子来了。
这秋岚狩猎，不仅是皇子之间的竞争，皇城各大势力都有参与。
可以说，机缘与凶险并存。
以前孟尘不在，如今还是第一次参加。
虞皇此举，也有意让兄弟几人消除隔阂，增进彼此的手足感情。
“父皇说的是！”
闻言，几个皇子纷纷起身，全都一副看好弟弟的模样盯着孟尘。
这一次，他们算是出血了。
针对孟尘不成，反而搭进去一些宝贝，还让孟尘趁机得到了禁令这种赏赐。
那些东西他们虽然不在意，但这口郁闷气却是令他们不爽。
几个皇子，皆皮笑肉不笑。
目光深处，看向孟尘的身影，好似在欣赏猎物一般。
秋岚狩猎，他们皆是身经百战，自然不是孟尘这么一个废人能比的。
即便，孟尘身边有强者保护，区区一个人也不够看。
到时候，真死在了那里，可怨不得别人了。
对于几个皇兄的目光，孟尘没当回事，不过这秋岚狩猎他却是饶有兴趣，到时候谁狩猎谁还尚未可知。
接风宴散去，孟尘没有离去，而是直接去了母妃的寝宫。
有禁令在身，自然一路无人阻拦。
甚至，都不需要孟尘将令牌掏出来。
虞皇接风宴上赏赐禁令的事，第一时间便传遍了整个皇宫，这些禁卫宫女们自然不敢阻拦，反而一个个恭敬无比。
甚至，一些小宫女都对这位没见过面的六皇子，心中充满了好奇。
若非宫内规矩森严，她们早忍不住去追着偷看六皇子去了。
刚才私下里，她们已经从接风宴侍奉回来的姐姐们说，六皇子温润儒雅，气度非凡，身上并没有其他皇子那般盛气凌人，是一位活脱脱的美男子。
相比于高高在上的其他几位皇子，反倒是这位刚回来的六皇子，更吸引她们，也更让她们敢接近一些。
不过，这种念头，这些宫女们也只敢心里想想，毕竟孟尘将要迎娶的，可是大虞第一女战神，黎清月。
她们就算生的在标致，论身份与容貌都是远远无法与黎清月相比的。
content_en:
They knew nothing about their father.
I'm afraid that Ning Guohou's deliberate targeting this time made Emperor Yu unhappy, so he deliberately rewarded Meng Chen with this ban in public.
Otherwise, rewards can be done in private.
After all, Meng Chen had met Emperor Yu in advance, and he didn't give it to him at that time, which shows that Emperor Yu didn't have such intention in the first place.
When Emperor Yu sent this ban, everyone in the palace was silent and did not even dare to say a word.
They didn't know whether Emperor Yu really loved Meng Chen.
But at the moment, he definitely supports Meng Chen, because this is the chess piece that he personally ordered to take back and grant a marriage to, hoping to use it to balance the forces of all parties.
Before Meng Chen became a big deal, how could he be allowed to be trampled on at this banquet?
As for questioning Meng Chen's secret defection to the enemy country, it is obviously ineffective.
It seems logical at first glance, but it doesn't make any sense when you think about it.
First of all, Meng Chen is from the royal family of Dayu. He was trapped in the enemy country for eight years for the peace of Dayu, and now Emperor Yu takes the initiative to take him back.
All of this was facilitated by Emperor Yu.
If you question Meng Chen, wouldn't you be going against Emperor Yu?
Now, they can only regain face from Qiulan hunting.
This Qiulan hunting was not only a competition between princes, but also involved all the major forces in the imperial city.
It can be said that opportunity and danger coexist.
Meng Chen was not here before, but now this is his first time to participate.
Emperor Yu's move was also intended to eliminate the barriers between the brothers and enhance their fraternal relationship.
"Father said so!"
Hearing this, several princes stood up one after another, all staring at Meng Chen as if they were optimistic about their younger brother.
This time, they were bleeding.
Instead of targeting Meng Chen, they got some treasures and allowed Meng Chen to take the opportunity to get a reward like a ban.
Although they didn't care about those things, this depressed air made them unhappy.
Several princes are all smiling but not smiling.
He looked deep into Meng Chen's figure, as if admiring prey.
Qiu Lan hunts, they are all experienced in many battles, naturally they are not comparable to a loser like Meng Chen.
Even if Meng Chen is protected by strong men, just one person is not enough.
When the time comes, if you really die there, you won’t be able to blame anyone else.
Meng Chen didn't take the looks from the imperial brothers seriously, but he was very interested in Qiu Lan's hunting. It was not yet known who was hunting whom.
After the reception banquet was over, Meng Chen did not leave, but went directly to his mother's palace.
With the ban in place, naturally no one will stop him along the way.
Meng Chen didn't even need to take out the token.
The news about the ban on rewards and bans given by Emperor Yu at the reception banquet was immediately spread throughout the palace. Naturally, these imperial guards and maidens did not dare to stop it. Instead, they were all extremely respectful.
Even some of the maids were full of curiosity about the sixth prince whom they had never met before.
If it weren't for the strict rules in the palace, they would have been chasing after the sixth prince and peeking at him.
Just now in private, their sisters, who had returned from serving at the Jie Feng Banquet, said that the Sixth Prince was gentle and elegant, with an extraordinary bearing. He was not as domineering as other princes. He was a truly handsome man.
Compared to the other princes who were above them, it was the newly returned sixth prince who attracted them more and made them dare to get closer.
However, these palace ladies only dared to think about this idea in their hearts. After all, Meng Chen was about to marry Li Qingyue, the first female war goddess in Dayu.
Even if they were born beautiful, their status and appearance were far from comparable to Li Qingyue's.
